title: Video Comic Brief
description: The complete input to the pipeline. This is also the unit of an eval case: one brief in, one storyboard out.

title.description: Optional. The Writer proposes one when absent.

language.description: BCP-47 tag. Drives reading speed and typography.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Required. Without a length budget the Writer has no stopping rule. Converted to a line budget before the Writer runs.

tone.description: Required-in-practice. Absent tone yields bland, register-less dialogue.

premise.description: Optional plot or situation. Quality degrades noticeably without it, but the pipeline must still produce something.

desiredEnding.description: Optional but high value. A short video with no intended landing point meanders. A punchline, a realisation, or a reversal.

mustIncludeLines.description: Verbatim lines that must survive editing. Checked mechanically.

requiredFacts.description: Facts the script must not contradict or omit. Checked by the Reviewer, not mechanically.

role.description: Job or social position. Shown on cast title cards.

traits.description: How they behave and speak. Drives both dialogue voice and expression range.

storyFunction.description: Optional. Strongest single signal for how the Writer should use them.

referencePhotos.description: Paths. Unused while assets are placeholders; required once image generation is wired in.

templateId.description: Omit to let the Director choose from the template registry.

outroText.description: Optional closing text card, e.g. a mock disclaimer.
